home.name: Sergei Bobrovsky
home.news: When the Maple Leafs signed Bobrovsky to a three-year, $7 million AAV contract ($21M total) in the offseason, the hope was that he could solidify their crease and return the team to the postseason. That said, Bobrovsky has struggled to start his tenure with the Maple Leafs, posting a subpar 3.34 GAA and .886 SV% in 12 games (3-7-2). Even more alarming, Bobrovsky has allowed three or more goals in all but one of his 12 outings. The veteran 38-year-old goalie hopes to snap a four-game losing streak on Tuesday, as the Maple Leafs enter as +146 home underdogs against a Colorado Avalanche team coming off a 4-0 win over the Detroit Red Wings.

home.name: Jacob Fowler
home.news: Fowler was outstanding in the opening month of the season, posting a 1.84 GAA and .932 SV% in eight October games (7-1-0). That said, he had a catastrophic meltdown in his first game of November, as the Montreal Canadiens blew a 4-0 lead over the Winnipeg Jets in the final three minutes of an eventual 5-4 overtime loss. That said, the 21-year-old Fowler wasn't phased by the loss, bouncing back in his most recent game with a solid outing, saving 26 of 28 shots (.929 SV%) in a 4-2 win over the Toronto Maple Leafs. The Canadiens enter Tuesday's game as +110 home underdogs against the Central Division-leading Minnesota Wild.

home.name: Samuel Ersson
home.news: Linus Ullmark (lower body) has ramped up intensity at practice, but will remain sidelined for at least one more game, with Ersson tending the twine on Tuesday. The 27-year-old Ersson had a rough start to his tenure with the Senators but has played well in recent games, prompting the team to take extra precautions with Ullmark's return. Ersson is riding a three-game winning streak, in which he has saved 76 of 80 shots (.950 SV%). The Senators enter Tuesday's game with even -105 odds at home against the Washington Capitals, who are coming off a 4-3 win over the Florida Panthers.

home.name: Cam Talbot
home.news: Jet Greaves was expected to lead the way between the pipes for Columbus this season, but early-season struggles have awarded Talbot increased playing time. That said, Greaves' struggles aside, Talbot has played well lately and earned his share of starts. The veteran 39-year-old goalie was excellent in his most recent outing, saving 31 of 32 shots (.969 SV%) in a 2-1 shootout win over the Dallas Stars. He has an outstanding 1.69 GAA and .942 SV% in his last four games (4-0-0). The Blue Jackets enter Tuesday's game as +104 home underdogs against a Florida Panthers team that is 1-3-0 in their last four games.

away.name: Jake Allen
away.news: In a highly anticipated game, the Devils management has opted to bench Connor Hellebuyck against his former team on Tuesday. Instead, the Devils will turn to Jake Allen, who has struggled against the Winnipeg Jets in his career, posting a 3.18 GAA and .884 SV% in 24 appearances (9-11-3). The 36-year-old goalie has allowed four or more goals in four of his last six games (4-2-0), posting a 3.45 GAA and .874 SV%.
